entities.summary: Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University (VBSPU), formerly Purvanchal University, is a public state university based in Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. It was established in 1987 as a residential-cum-affiliating university. It is named after Shri Veer Bahadur Singh, the former chief minister of Uttar Pradesh. Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University is a university in Asia, established in 1987. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
